entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I've been on hold for ten minutes. I need to return this ridiculous helmet I bought. This is unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied, and I apologize for the wait time. I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Ugh, fine, hold on. It's VF88910. I expect a full refund. The color is completely different from the website, and it's been sitting in my garage forever. The box is unopened, so there should be no issue.
Thank you for that. Let me just pull up your order... VF88910... Okay, I see the purchase here for the AeroPro Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 83 days ago, on October 24th, 2025.

And? Your policy is 90 days! I've read it. Are you trying to get out of this? This is a critical piece of safety equipment, and I can't use it if the color is wrong. I'll post a review on every website you're on! Let me speak to your manager.
Sir, there's no need for that. Please allow me just a moment to confirm the policy for this specific item. One moment.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've double-checked, and you are absolutely correct. This helmet falls under our 90-day return window. Since you are at day 83, I can approve this return for you right now.
Well, you should have known that from the beginning. Fine. Just process it. Send me the label.

Of course. I have just processed the return authorization. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. Please ensure the helmet is in its original box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center.
It better get there fast. I want my money back this week.
Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No. Just make sure it gets done.
It will be. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
